prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: Kiddo Arabia recipe listing and recipe detail photo, landscape 3:2.
Primary request: realistic overnight oats with berries, showing the exact dish prepared from whole-grain rolled oats, milk, plain yogurt, chia seeds and honey.
Scene/backdrop: warm white kitchen table, soft natural window light, quiet pale neutral background.
Subject: two clear short glass jars filled with pale creamy soaked whole-grain oats with visible oat texture and tiny chia specks, topped with fresh sliced strawberries and blueberries. A few loose berries and a plain spoon nearby.
Composition/framing: close food photograph at a gentle 45-degree angle, both jars entirely within frame, main jar centered, food fills most of frame, clear edible texture, simple natural food styling.
Style/medium: photorealistic editorial food photography, appetizing but believable.
Constraints: no blended pink smoothie, no cornflakes, no cereal rings, no biscuit base, no packaging, no logo, no text, no watermark, no people. All toppings correspond to strawberries and blueberries.
